items.Sentence: The SOCWA RTP treats solids produced by the SOCWA RTP, raw solids trucked to the SOCWA RTP from the El Toro WRP, and raw solids transported by force main to the SOCWA RTP from the SOCWA CTP. Solids treatment consists of dissolved air flotation thickening, anaerobic digestion, and centrifuge dewatering.
